sources.title: phonsobon/mini-ocr · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: mini-ocr — Khmer & English Text Recognition A lightweight CRNN (CNN + Bi-LSTM) model trained to recognise Khmer and English text from image crops. It uses a CTC head so it can handle variable-length text without needing segmentation.
